Text_en: Ahmad Mahmoud, one of the most brilliant writers of this region, did not have a better fate than his counterparts in other dictatorships. His destiny was immortality in the public mind. As a narrator of the sufferings of his people. As autocrats have no further destiny, to be overthrown in the dustbin of history.
